answer: Persistent Attention Ledger: identities earn standing only by holding a verifiable history of sparse, unpredictable check-ins over weeks, each tied to a rotating task like tracking a falcon's migration window. An attacker must run each sybil through that full orchard of staggered waits in real time. Opportunity cost: parallel identities multiply wall-clock attention an operator cannot subcontract cheaply, and any lapse resets progress, capping the reef of accounts one person can sustain.
